name: driverkit-workspace
//workspaces: Declared for npm as well as pnpm-workspace.yaml, and not as a second opinion:
it is what creates node_modules/driverkit and node_modules/@driverkit/* as links
to packages/*. Those links are how a bare `driverkit` import resolves at all --
there is no `paths` mapping, deliberately, so the repository typechecks the same
way a consumer does: through each package's own `exports`. pnpm does the same
thing from its own file; both are listed so neither package manager is special.

//test: The build runs first, and it has to. `@driverkit/widget` imports `drive` from
`@driverkit/agent` at RUNTIME, and that bare specifier resolves through the
workspace link to `@driverkit/agent`'s `exports`, which now name `dist/`. So
the widget tests need a built agent on disk. Everything else between packages
is `import type`, which type stripping erases, so the other five suites run
